snippet.title: Tidy Town Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4994380/Tidy_Town/
Check out the announce trailer for our upcoming game! Tidy Town is a third person cleaning game where you combine everyday objects to tidy up messes and transform spaces. Help Percy lend a paw one room at a time as he saves a friend’s cafe, rebuilds a city park, refreshes an artist’s studio and tidies his way across town and into his community's heart.

Wishlist this cozy tidying adventure today!

Music by Dustin Wilde
